mapper.update: UPDATE t_exam_record r INNER JOIN t_exam_answer target ON target.exam_record_id = r.exam_record_id SET r.total_score = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(all_answer.final_score), 0) FROM t_exam_answer all_answer WHERE all_answer.exam_record_id = r.exam_record_id) WHERE target.answer_id = #{answerId}
